description_en: Registers multiple devices under a product. The DeviceNames of these devices are randomly generated
description_zh: 指定产品下批量注册多个设备（随机生成设备名）
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-register-device --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --count 100 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchRegisterDevice

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
